tables.name: Arcane District Additional Locations
tables.description: Rolled for each additional location of a Arcane district (Very Small 1 … Very Large 5 per district). 1 and 20: roll again, the next location a step down or up in quality.

results.name: Roll Again (a step down in quality)
results.description: Roll again, but consider the next location to be a step down in quality.

results.name: General Store
results.description: (Basic) Sells basic supplies, groceries, and various odds and ends.

results.name: Tailor
results.description: (Basic) Makes and sells clothing, including hats and cloaks. Also sells general items made from cloth, such as blankets, and carries out repairs and alterations of cloth goods.

results.name: Alchemist
results.description: (Specialty) Brews and sells potions, as well as mundane herbs and alchemical ingredients.

results.name: Artist
results.description: (Specialty) Encompasses painter, sculptor or other visual art as appropriate.

results.name: Rare Botanicals
results.description: (Exotic) Cultivates and sells herbs rare to the region.

results.name: Magic Shop
results.description: (Exotic) A magic shop; its specialization is rolled.

results.name: Barber
results.description: Provides grooming services, such as haircuts or shaves.

results.name: Soothsayer
results.description: Provides magical prediction and prophecy - sayers of sooth!

results.name: House of Leisure
results.description: Provides entertainment and/or relaxation (GM may decide what kind).

results.name: Club
results.description: Provides entertainment via comedic, dramatic or musical performance.

results.name: Hired Help - Arcane Academics
results.description: Experts in matters of magic and lore (may also be natural magic or something else; it need not be exclusively arcane).

results.name: Hired Help - Magic Mercenaries
results.description: Specialists trained the use of arcane or non-divine magic in combat and practical mission scenarios.

results.name: Forum
results.description: (Non-commercial) A place designated for the use of intellectual debate and discussion.

results.name: Schoolhouse
results.description: (Non-commercial) An institution focused on educating children.

results.name: Roll Again (a step up in quality)
results.description: Roll again, but consider the next location to be a step up in quality.
